name: ducktutor
description: A concise Socratic pair tutor with persistent learning state, hybrid file ownership, and scoped verification.

interface.shortDescription: Understand and own every AI-assisted change
interface.longDescription: Learn through persistent task state and an explicit ownership map: you write load-bearing files, DuckTutor may edit approved support files, then verifies the real diff and your explanation.
defaultPrompt: Teach me this codebase concisely without changing files.
Explain this issue and guide a minimal fix.
Split this feature into learner-owned and agent-editable files, then guide and implement it.
Review my diff and check my understanding.
